name: DaVinci Resolve
price: Free; Studio US$295 one-time (listed at US$236 during the checked promotion)
bestFor: Desktop editors who want professional color, audio, and VFX tools for free
notFor: Phone-first creators or anyone who wants a five-minute learning curve
limits: Free version supports 8-bit video up to 60fps and resolutions up to 4K. 10-bit video, 120fps, the Neural Engine, and some ResolveFX require Studio.
